title: Derived module Hom transport from coherent geometric object comparisons
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ any cocone, $i\in I$, $Y$ affine [def-pc-scheme], and $s:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}R(i)$. Assume scheme-derived categories with Hom universe $w$ and module-derived categories with Hom universe $u+1$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$, let $F:\{j\mid i\le j\}\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ be any diagram, and let $C$ be any cocone on $F$ and $E,K$ arbitrary complexes over $F(i)$. At each stage $j$ let $E_j,K_j$ be their scalar extensions to $F(j)$, and let $E_\infty,K_\infty$ be their extensions to $C.pt$. Let $T_A$ denote termwise tilde from complexes over $A$ to complexes on $\operatorname{Spec}A$. Assume derived equivalences $d_j:D(\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}F(j)})\simeq D(\mathcal O_{Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R(i)}\operatorname{Spec}R(j)})$ and the analogous $d_\infty$, and isomorphisms $\alpha E_j:d_j(Q(T_{F(j)}E_j))\cong Lp_j^*P$, $\alpha K_j:d_j(Q(T_{F(j)}K_j))\cong Lp_j^*Q$, and $\beta E,\beta K$ at the limit, where $p_j,p_\infty$ are the prescribed first pullback projections [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Define $C_j(f)=(\alpha E_j)^{-1}\circ d_j(Q(T_{F(j)}f))\circ\alpha K_j$ in Lean's left-to-right composition convention, and similarly $C_\infty$. Assume $C_k(\operatorname{scalarExtensionHom}_{j,k}(f))=\operatorname{perfectStageMap}_{j,k}(C_j(f))$ and $C_\infty(\operatorname{scalarExtensionHom}_{j,\infty}(f))=\operatorname{perfectLimitMap}_j(C_j(f))$ for every chain map, with the maps and ring-map equalities of [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom] and [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. Then there are equivalences $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(F(j))}(QE_j,QK_j)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(Lp_j^*P,Lp_j^*Q)$ and the analogous limit equivalence satisfying those same two equations on localized chain maps. This asserts neither boundedness nor existence of the supplied geometric comparison data. The generic cocone C need not be colimiting; the supplied comparison data contain its two compatibility equations. In the specified affine model application C is the actual colimit cocone of F.

proof.text: For any A,M,N use [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence], the full inclusion of the quasi-coherent derived subcategory, and Iso.homCongr on its localization factorization. This produces the affine derived Hom equivalence. Naturality of the factorization, precomposed by its inverse component, proves its chain-map formula. This step is already proved by private exists_affineTildeHomEquiv in this module. Choose the resulting equivalences simultaneously for rings and pairs of complexes, then specialize to the stage rings and the abstract cocone point C.pt.

For each stage and the limit, compose the affine tilde Hom equivalence with the fully faithful Hom equivalence of the supplied derived equivalence, then conjugate by the supplied object isomorphisms. The proved private exists_affineTransportedHomEquiv supplies this equivalence and its chain-map formula. Choose the stage equivalences simultaneously. For a stage transition, compose the chain-map formula at the destination with the corresponding identity from affineModelComparisonData, then use congruence of perfectStageMap applied to the inverse of the source chain-map formula. The limit identity follows in exactly the same way using perfectLimitMap. No additional mathematical dependency is needed.

theorem exists_affineModelHomTransportAssembly
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (C : Cocone F)
    (E K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)) ℤ)
    (hcomp : affineModelComparisonData R c i Y s P Q F C E K) :
      ∃ (stage : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))).obj Q))
        (limit :
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (C.ι.app ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (C.ι.app ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k)
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          stage k (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (F.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom
              (F.map (homOfLE k.property)).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map_comp
                (homOfLE j.property) (homOfLE hjk))) E K f)) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.val.property hjk
              (stage j (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i))
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          limit (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (C.ι.app j.val).hom
              (C.ι.app ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (C.w (homOfLE j.property)).symm)
              E K f)) =
            perfectLimitMap R c s j.val.property
              (stage j (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)))
